title: Upgrade tonic to v0.14.6 in qdrant gRPC API layer
mini_srs: Upgrade the qdrant contract repository gRPC framework from tonic 0.11/prost-build to tonic 0.14.6/tonic-prost-build. The build system in lib/api/build.rs switches from tonic_build::configure() to tonic_prost_build::configure() with compile_protos(), adds tonic-prost runtime crate to Cargo.toml, and emits explicit cargo:rerun-if-changed directives to work around a tonic-prost-build regression (grpc-rust #2415). All protobuf bindings in qdrant.rs and grpc.health.v1.rs are regenerated with the new codegen which auto-derives Eq and Hash on message types.

title: Upgrade tonic/prost/reqwest dependencies in rust-client SDK
mini_srs: Upgrade the rust-client SDK core dependencies to tonic 0.14.6 with tonic-prost runtime, prost 0.14.3, reqwest 0.13.4, and thiserror 2.0. The tonic-prost-build codegen now auto-derives Eq and Hash for message types where possible, making the manual Hash implementation for PointId redundant. The reqwest upgrade renames the rustls-tls feature to rustls. The generated src/qdrant.rs is fully regenerated with the new toolchain.

title: QdrantServerless Rust Client
mini_srs: Delivers the QdrantServerless client for the Rust SDK targeting the managed serverless offering. Prototype introduces serverless module at src/serverless/ with client, conversions, gRPC bindings, and models. Subsequent commits add paginated ListCollections with text index options, expose response time on CollectionsService RPCs, and add FULL precision tier for exact f32 vectors.

title: QdrantServerless Python Client
mini_srs: Delivers the QdrantServerless client for the Python SDK with sync and async clients for the managed serverless offering. Creates qdrant_client/serverless/ package with async_client.py, client.py, conversions.py, models.py, gRPC bindings, and standalone proto. Follow-ups expose response time on CollectionsService RPCs and add FULL precision tier.

title: Resource Management: Strict Mode to Global Quotas
mini_srs: Implements the qdrant-side resource management lifecycle. d75d805 adds max_disk_usage_percent to strict mode in collections.proto (field 22). c34acc1 supersedes it with node-wide QuotaConfig API creating quota_internal.proto with GetQuotaUsage RPC, reserves field 22 on StrictModeConfig, and deprecates max_resident_memory_percent.

title: Fix Stale Snapshot Transfer Breaking Cluster
mini_srs: Fixes cluster-breaking bug where stale shard transfer requests replayed after sender restart could wipe receiver's shard data. Adds from_peer_id validation to InitiateShardTransferRequest and RecoverShardSnapshotRequest in internal service protos.

title: Qdrant v1.19-v1.20 Contract Foundation: TurboQuant, Memory Placement, IDF Corpus, BM25 Stemmer

title: Remove max_disk_usage_percent and Deprecate max_resident_memory_percent in Python Client

title: Per-Element Nested Payload Indexes
mini_srs: Adds per-element (nested) payload indexes to the qdrant API layer. Introduces nested parameter on all eight payload index param types in REST and gRPC APIs enabling indexing of each array element as a separate entry. Follow-on extends null index to operate per-element for correct is_empty semantics.

title: Sync Nested Payload Index Parameters to Rust Client
mini_srs: Syncs the per-element nested payload index parameters from qdrant contract to rust-client SDK. Adds nested setter to every IndexParamsBuilder (keyword, integer, float, geo, text, bool, datetime, uuid) and updates qdrant.rs struct definitions.

title: Substring Match Filter Condition
mini_srs: Adds unindexed text substring matching as a new filter condition (Match.substring) in qdrant_common.proto and corresponding conversions. Distinct from indexed MatchText — serves the keyword index key dictionary or scans payload values.

title: Slice Filter Condition and Deprecated Search Removal
mini_srs: Introduces SliceCondition filter for deterministic id-space sampling in qdrant_common.proto (55cf6b7) and removes deprecated Search, Recommend, and Discover REST endpoints from the OpenAPI spec while marking corresponding gRPC RPCs deprecated (73e6c16 in points_service.proto). Together these represent contract-level filter additions and endpoint deprecations for the v1.19 cycle.

title: Filter and Prefix SDK Consumption in Python Client

title: Keyword Index Prefix Matching
mini_srs: Adds opt-in prefix matching to keyword payload indexes in the qdrant gRPC API. New KeywordPrefixParams message in collections.proto and prefix variant in Match oneof in qdrant_common.proto enable efficient byte-wise prefix filtering over keyword values for URL prefix filtering and facet-based autocompletion. SDK consumption occurs through v1.19 sync commits in M07.

title: BM25 Text Search Pipeline and Id Tracker Memory and Formula Expressions

Extends unified memory placement to point id tracker with cached placement support (9614dc0, 333ca00). Adds acosh, max, and min operators to formula expressions (fe27f6a, aba9516, f8acc7c). title: Opt-In Connection Check on Client Build
mini_srs: Adds opt-in connection check to Rust Qdrant client build() method. gRPC connections are lazy so build() succeeds even when server is unreachable. New check_connection config flag makes build() perform health check and return error eagerly. Default behavior unchanged for backward compatibility.
